tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.name: Conditional code tests
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.description: Checks that the code scanners read the right branch of build-specific code.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.name: Name-matching scanner limit
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.description: Stops new checks being added that match code by spelling instead of by meaning.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.name: Record ownership check
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.description: Checks that every kind of stored record in the real app has one owning module.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.name: Record ownership scanner
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.description: Scans the stored-record layout to find links that cross from one module's records to another's.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.name: Record ownership tests
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.description: Checks on small samples that cross-module record links are caught.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.name: Two-step sign-in ownership tests
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.description: Checks that one place decides if two-step sign-in is required and one place enforces it.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Catalo.name: Catalog edit version tests
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Catalo.description: Checks that editing a product or pack size must carry the version the editor loaded.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Common.name: Audit log wording check
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Common.description: Checks that every action and record type in the audit log has a matching entry in the screens' filter lists.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Common.name: Farm date rule tests
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Common.description: Checks that date rules use the farm's own local today, not the server's.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Common.name: Fixed farm clock
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Common.description: Provides a frozen farm-local today so date rules can be tested.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Custom.name: Customer rule matching tests
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Custom.description: Checks that creating and editing a customer enforce the same rules on the same five fields.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Custom.name: Customer edit tests
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Custom.description: Checks the steps that save changes to a customer.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Custom.name: Customer edit rule tests
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Custom.description: Checks the rules that reject bad values when a customer is edited.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/DailyE.name: Daily entry rule tests
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/DailyE.description: Checks the rules that reject bad values when a day's egg and flock numbers are recorded.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Docume.name: Account rename docs check
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Docume.description: Checks that the written explanation of renaming an account matches what the code does.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Docume.name: Farm separation docs check
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Docume.description: Checks that the documents on keeping farms' data apart are up to date.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/EggGra.name: Low-stock floor tests
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/EggGra.description: Checks who may change a low-stock floor and what counts as below it.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/EggLot.name: Egg lot movement rule tests
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/EggLot.description: Checks the rules that reject bad values when egg stock is moved in or out.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Eggs/E.name: Egg lot locking order check
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Eggs/E.description: Checks that every lock on egg lots is taken in the same order, so two actions cannot block each other.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Eggs/E.name: Egg operations read tests
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Eggs/E.description: Checks that reading egg records copies each field to the right place.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Expens.name: Finance read tests
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Expens.description: Checks that reading expense records copies each field to the right place.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Flocks.name: New flock rule tests
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Flocks.description: Checks the rules that reject bad values when a flock is created.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Flocks.name: Flock lookup tests
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Flocks.description: Checks that looking up a flock copies each field to the right place.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Flocks.name: Flock loss record tests
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Flocks.description: Checks that recording bird losses adds the right kind of entry and leaves saving to the caller.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/FlockS.name: Flock filter coverage check
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/FlockS.description: Works out from the stored-record layout which records are limited by flock and checks each is covered.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/FlockS.name: Flock filter guard tests
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/FlockS.description: Checks the guard that limits what workers see to their own flocks.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Global.name: Shared test imports
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Global.description: Sets the common imports every test file in this group uses.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Invent.name: Inventory read tests
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Invent.description: Checks that reading stock records copies each field to the right place.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Sales/.name: Add order line tests
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Sales/.description: Checks that a line added to an order in a different unit gets the product's price converted correctly.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Sales/.name: Sales read tests
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Sales/.description: Checks that reading sales records copies each field to the right place.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Sales/.name: Confirm sale rule tests
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Sales/.description: Checks the rules that reject a sale confirmation with a bad discount.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Sales/.name: Discount reason list check
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Sales/.description: Checks that the discount reasons in the server match the list the confirm-sale screen shows.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Sales/.name: Sale stock allocation tests
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Sales/.description: Checks that a whole order is filled from the oldest egg stock first.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Sales/.name: Transaction code shape check
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Sales/.description: Checks the code's shape so work done inside a transaction is written the expected way.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Tenant.name: Farm filter bypass list
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Tenant.description: Lists the places allowed to read data without the one-farm-only filter.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Tenant.name: Farm directory use check
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Tenant.description: Checks that only allowed code reads the list of every farm.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Tenant.name: Unfiltered lookup identity tests
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Tenant.description: Checks that each unfiltered lookup is identified in a stable way that cannot excuse a second one.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Tenant.name: Unfiltered lookup list
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Tenant.description: Lists each place that reads records without the farm filter, with its classification.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Tenant.name: Farm code lookup check
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Tenant.description: Checks that only allowed code finds an account by farm code, which ignores the farm filter.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Tenant.name: Farm filter bypass scanner
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Tenant.description: Scans the code for reads that skip the one-farm-only filter and compares them with the allowed list.
